paragraphs: Creditspring’s mission to boost financial stability through subscription products mirrors my focus on building reliable, scalable models that directly impact user outcomes. I have crafted end‑to‑end pipelines that translate data into actionable insights for consumers.

I built scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker. This ensured rapid, reproducible delivery of predictive models to production environments.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python (FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI) for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client, presenting it in a live stakeholder demo.
